messages.subject: 5-a-side Thursday?
messages.plaintextBody:
James — are you about for the firm 5-a-side on Thursday? We're a couple short and the pitch is booked for 6:30 at the Shoreditch courts. Bring the bibs if you still have them from last time. Pub after.

Tom
